children: Dorian LPG entered into a new $368.4 million seven-year credit facility to refinance existing indebtedness, including the 2023 A&R Debt Facility, certain Japanese financings, and a BALCAP tranche. The sustainability-linked facility is led by Nordea Bank and Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken, with Credit Agricole serving as Sustainability Coordinator alongside BNP Paribas, Danish Ship Finance, DNB Carnegie, ING Capital, and OCBC among the lenders. The agreement is expected to enhance liquidity, extend maturities, and align financing with ESG objectives.
: Syndicate led by Nordea Bank and Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken, including Credit Agricole, BNP Paribas, Danish Ship Finance, DNB Carnegie, ING Capital, and OCBC
: Refinance debt and add sustainability-linked flexibility
